_rationale: RMD at 73 = 500000/26.5 = 18867.92. With $0 spending, the full RMD is forced excess. The iteration loop converges on a spending-based withdrawal that covers only the tax on the RMD (since the RMD is ordinary income). The full 18867.92 is taken from Traditional; rmdExcess = rmdRequired minus the tax-covering portion, and the remainder deposits to Taxable. rmdRequired ≈ 18868. Traditional drops by ~18868; Taxable grows by rmdExcess. Total portfolio shrinks only by the tax (~$0 due to standard deduction absorbing most of the RMD amount).

breakdownChecks._note: Most of the RMD is excess (spending ≈ tax-only amount)

pathValues._note: 0% return + 0 tax (deductions exceed RMD) → Traditional $481,132 + Taxable $118,868 = $600,000 exactly. Fails at ~$581,132 if deposit is broken.
